run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the sum of all odd factors of a given integer n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter set of ten integers
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold algorithm that strips even factors then accumulates odd prime factor sums
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a helper function for the odd prime factor geometric series calculation
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like n equals 1 or negative input values
